verdict.rationale: Gladia documents no first-party way to define event-triggered rules or automations. The only related evidence is third-party integration partners (Zapier, Make, n8n), where the rule engine belongs to the external platform, and that is a user-side workaround rather than Gladia's own capability. Features like automatic PII redaction are processing options, not user-defined event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
